prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Dallas for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist—the right choice depends on your bite, treatment goals, budget, and location. A good starting point is to compare **two or three orthodontists who completed specialty orthodontic training**, then ask each for a full exam and treatment plan.

A few Dallas options to consider:

- **Dr. Patricia Simon, Lakewood Orthodontics** — board-certified, with more than 25 years in the Dallas area; offers braces and Invisalign. [Practice website](https://www.lakewoodortho.net/)
- **Dr. Shad Hanis** — listed by the American Association of Orthodontists as board-certified; Dallas office on LBJ Freeway. [AAO profile](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/dr-shad-hanis-4/)
- **Dr. Judy Choi and Dr. Megan Meyer, Walnut Central Orthodontics** — the practice offers Invisalign and braces. [Practice information](https://nationalorthodonticregistry.com/texas/dallas-tx/orthodontists/walnut-central-orthodontics-dallas-tx)
- **Dr. Hessam Rahimi, Fusion Orthodontics** — board-certified and offers Invisalign and several braces options. [Practice website](https://www.fusionorthodontics.com/)

At consultations, ask who will supervise your treatment, whether Invisalign or braces is a better fit for your specific bite, what’s included in the fee (including retainers and refinements), and how emergencies or missed appointments are handled. You can also verify orthodontic specialty credentials through the [AAO locator](https://aaoinfo.org/locator/).

If you share your Dallas neighborhood, whether this is for an adult or child, and whether you prefer braces or Invisalign, I can narrow the list.
